title: Broccoli Soup
description: A large-batch creamy pareve broccoli soup made with vegetable broth, Coffee Rich and potato starch.

steps.instruction: Boil water add vegetable broth, white pepper then add chopped broccoli, bring to boil and immediately remove from heat.
Sautee onions, drain and add to soup.
Add Coffee Rich and mix thoroughly.
Add potato starch to soup(first mixing it with cold water) and stir thoroughly.

notes: Add 1 to 2 tablespoons granulated garlic to cover up onion taste if onion taste is too extreme.
